title: 802.15.4: have separate dissectors for "FCS type specified" and not.
description:
Have separate dissectors for the case where the caller passes the FCS
type through te data argument and for which it doesn't.  For dissectors
called from the wtap_encap dissector table, the data argument points to
a pseudo-header, not to an int value containing the FCS type, so the
dissector was seeing what it throught was an FCS type of 0, and not
allowing the user preference to control what type of FCS is present.

Fixes the issue mentioned by merge request !26224.
